# SameDayRepairs.com.au - Emergency Repair & Trade Directory

> Australia's verified on-demand emergency trade directory. Connecting Australian homeowners and commercial premises with licensed whitegoods technicians, emergency plumbers, 24/7 locksmiths, electricians, and garage door specialists with guaranteed same-day arrival. Upfront diagnostic pricing from $149, audited state trade licences (QBCC, NSW Fair Trading, VBA), and 12-month parts warranties.

## Emergency Hotline
- **Direct Dispatch Line**: [0468 991 300](tel:0468991300)
- **International Emergency Line**: [+61 468 991 300](tel:+61468991300)
- **Hours**: 24/7 Priority Emergency Breakdown Triage

(Diagnostic callout from $149, credited towards approved repairs).

## Trade Standards & Compliance
- **Licensing**: All contractors audited against QBCC (Queensland), Fair Trading (NSW), and Victorian Building Authority (VBA).
- **Insurance**: $20 Million Public Liability certificate of currency mandatory for directory listing.
- **Warranty**: All replacement parts and workmanship backed by minimum 12-month statutory guarantee.
- **Payment**: Mobile on-van EFTPOS terminals accepting Visa, Mastercard, and digital wallets with itemized GST tax invoices.
